name: review-your-papers
description: Two paper-review skills: an advisor-guided review of a student's draft that proposes small revisions to accept or reject on an editing page, and peer reviews of others' papers in Hang Yu's reviewing style on a review page with evidence under each point.

interface.shortDescription: Advisor-guided paper reviews and peer reviews
interface.longDescription: Review a student's paper draft with Elaine Schaertl Short's advisor guide, proposing small revisions with reasons that the author accepts, rejects, or edits on a page before they are applied to the LaTeX source. Or draft a peer review of someone else's paper in Hang Yu's reviewing style, with the evidence for every point on a review page. Wording follows a bundled portable writing style guide.
defaultPrompt: Use advisor-review-paper to review my paper draft, proposing small revisions with reasons for me to accept or reject.
Use review-paper to draft a peer review of the manuscript in this folder.
